Planet Sushi Budapest
The first Planet Sushi restaurant was opened in 2006 on Oktogon square. With its exciting sushi selections and a wide variety of main dishes, it quickly became the favorite Japanese restaurant in the neighborhood.
Planet Sushi opened the second restaurant in Újbuda in May 2017 in the Allee Shopping Center. The interior design of the restaurant is unique.
